channel.title: MITRE Corporation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by MITRE Corporation (mitre).

item.title: CVE-2026-52295
item.description: Buffer Overflow vulnerability in Ffmpeg v.7.0 and after allows an attacker to cause a denial of service via the libavformat/iamf_writer.c component

item.title: CVE-2026-52132
item.description: llama.cpp through commit 97f06e9, when started with the --reranking flag, allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (std::bad_alloc and HTTP 500) via a negative top_n value in a POST request to /rerank.

item.title: CVE-2026-52131
